environment.note: PostgreSQL 17.12 and LocalStack Core 4.14.0 native services; three Bun processes; application database role jungle_app; publisher polling 250ms; executor resource limits not calibrated

methodology.duplicateRule: every fifth request replays the preceding identity
methodology.warmup: wallet creation and metrics fetch excluded
methodology.measurement: HTTP submission only; reconciliation after the measured interval
methodology.money: 1.00 BRL per unique BET, 1000000.00 BRL initial balance per wallet

limitations: Short local measurement; not a production capacity estimate.
Outbox publication is asynchronous; HTTP throughput is not event-consumer throughput.
A single run provides no statistical confidence interval.
